text:
Anita: Quick sync 8a PT										
We have to decide which features get the MVP flag and which we roll to v1. Also callout: last night's regression pushed timeline by ~1 week. Can we re-slice without blowing the pilot?

Ralph: Short answer: yes but need hard acceptance criteria for pilot. If pilots see >3% error increase or SLA latency +50ms we hold. We should codify this in the roadmap PR as gating checks.

Diego: From infra: if we remove advanced analytics we free up two infra tickets. But we still need the embeddings cache and a prefix cache warmup job. Those are low effort.

Anita: Proposal: two-tier cutlist 
- MVP required: user auth, basic SSO pilot gating, embeddings cache, tenant routing core
- MVP optional (gated): tenant SSO (pilot only), export CSV, observability dashboards (limited)
- Defer to v1: analytics UI, ad-hoc routing rules, on-prem installer polish

Sam: QA concerns: we need a short test matrix for gated SSO. If it's behind a flag we still have to validate token claims, session rotation, and failure modes. I can own a checklist.

Priya: Agree on gated SSO. Ask sales to confirm pilot acceptance criteria (Diego/Tomas earlier asked) and we commit to timeline offset if they accept the gated path. Also we should set a clear rollback window for any heavy routes.

Ralph: Canary suggestion: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitor 5xx, p95 latency, and token auth failures. If any alert fires, auto-rollback.

QA-bot: test-plan/created: 1739998273-gated-sso-smoke (owner: Sam) 
checks: auth-smoke, session-rotation, api-error-boundary

Diego: Timeline note: regression fixed but we lost one infra sprint. If we accept the two-tier cut we still hit soft-launch in 2 weeks, hard-launch 4 weeks.

Anita: Action items: 
1) Sam -> attach gated SSO test checklist + expected durations by EOD today
2) Ralph -> create canary playbook and add rollback hooks by EOD
3) Priya -> update roadmap PR with the two-tier cut and the explicit gating criteria
4) Diego -> schedule cache warmup and note DB index prewarm window

Priya: If we all sign off I'll mark this MVP slice and update release timeline. Please ping if acceptance criteria changes.

Sam: Will post test checklist in thread when ready. :white_check_mark:

Ralph: Adding canary playbook draft now. :hammer_and_wrench:

Anita: Thanks all. If sales needs a conservative commitment tell them pilot gating + v1+6 weeks for residency is our external message.

Priya: Noted. I'll coordinate messaging with Tomas and Sales. :mailbox_with_mail:
